confidence_notes: A June 2026 [Numbeo snapshot](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Seattle) informs meals, coffee and beer; a [Seattle nightlife guide](https://citiesinsider.com/country/united-states/seattle/nightlife-and-entertainment) informs cocktails. Wine is estimated from beer prices and limited [local comparisons](https://haphunt.com/reports/seattle-happy-hour-prices-2026). Lodging is a holistic July estimate and is especially uncertain with summer and event demand. Prices generally exclude taxes, tips and fees.
comparable_city_reasoning: Seattle is a high-cost Pacific Northwest city, with prices generally above Portland and closer to San Francisco; July visitor demand informs the lodging estimates.
